proposals.premise: The narrow bridge path rules out a group stop, so route choice must foreground the step-free alternate while keeping all three sounds in sequence.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens with the walking route beside the three licensed photographs; phone opens with the next reachable stop, timing, and a compact route strip sharing the screen.
proposals.move: The first control chooses the direct or step-free route; the updated next stop and timing appear immediately above the route, with bell and bridge preview buttons.
proposals.tradeoff: Immediate viability reduces uncertainty, but photographs receive less space on phone.

proposals.premise: The choir ending at 20:30 makes time the route’s key constraint, while the bell and 46-second bridge sound can animate progress without implying a choir recording.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens as an evening timeline paired with a photograph and route map; phone shows the next reachable stop first, with its timing, image, and route choice sharing one card.
proposals.move: The first control selects a departure time; the page reveals a viable sequence, flags the choir deadline, and places available bell or bridge playback beside the relevant stop.
proposals.tradeoff: Time-first planning makes feasibility clear, but the full route is less immediately visible.
